name: HyperFrames by HeyGen
what: HTML video: a composition is one HTML file with a paused GSAP timeline that renders to MP4, WebM or MOV. Two paths: a hosted MCP for chat clients and local skills plus a CLI for coding agents. The owner calls this tool "HeyGen". It is not an avatar-video tool.
install: Hosted path: attach the HyperFrames by HeyGen connector in the host's connector settings. Local path: npx skills add heygen-com/hyperframes (in scripts: npx hyperframes skills update).
firstCall: get-send-to-hyperframes-guide before authoring a composition for import; local path: read the installed /hyperframes skill; otherwise none
evidenceNote: Tool schemas, server instructions, the Send to HyperFrames guide and the public README read. One live read call (list_projects) succeeded. No compose, render, import or feedback call ran. Local skills were not installed. No HeyGen avatar-video connector was found in the researched session.
